title: 第11章 仙道潜力 已签约求收藏追读推荐第12章 复盘 求推荐求月票
content_zh:
执法堂事了，楚无忌转身去了藏经阁。
藏经阁外松风作响，檐角铜铃轻鸣，氛围比执法堂轻松许多。
既然贡献点无倒扣之虞，楚无忌也不再犹豫。他便把当值执事所得，连同往日攒下的贡献点，统统用掉，来藏经阁兑换了两门功法秘术。
第一门，是一部辅助炼体的功法《玄罡炼体功》，专补筋骨皮肉，打熬气血。此功在练气阶段也算一流炼体法门，虽进境略慢，却无需诸般天材地宝便可夯实根基，正好为日后筑基三关中的肉身关做些准备。筑基三关，法力、肉身、神识，缺一不可，皆需蜕变方能筑就道基。
另外是一门出手迅捷的风刃术，与他风灵根相得益彰，全力催动之下，锋芒凌厉，威力不下于高阶法器。
那名只有高阶法器，却一路杀进真传的狠人，便靠的是出手快、衔接准，几道法术几乎瞬发，连绵不绝，硬生生击败了一名拿出符宝却无暇激发的家族修士。符宝再强，若催动不及，落不到对手身上，也不过只是个摆设。
走出藏经阁，楚无忌停下脚步，目光越过石阶尽头，落在远处丹峰的方向。
要想获得筑基丹的话。
斗法过于凶险，哪怕在擂台上能赢，也得顾着别下手太重，免得被人顺势做局，连辩都无处辩。可若畏首畏尾之下，难免出了差错。
那么，只剩一条路。
百艺十席。
炼丹、炼器、制符、阵法……诸般修仙百艺之中，他最中意的，终究还是炼丹。
可炼丹不是嘴上说说。门槛摆在那里：大量灵石。
在乱星海，修士间有一句广为流传的俗语“炼丹穷三代，炼器毁一生。”
说的便是丹道耗材如海，试错报废一炉接一炉，灵石像流水般往外淌，足以掏空几代积蓄；而炼器更凶，失败损耗更大，还容易炸炉伤身，轻则毁法器毁材料，重则伤经脉、毁道基，直接断了修行路。
楚无忌摸了摸储物袋，里头是这些年攒下的零碎灵石，掂来掂去也不到十块。可若真要踏上丹道，这点灵石怕是连一口像样的炼丹炉都买不起。
没钱修什么仙？
可他也不是空口白牙来碰运气的。
早在前些日子，他便打听清楚：丹峰为了扩充可用之人，便将丹峰多余的灵石，拿出来给一部分想学炼丹的弟子大开方便之门，提升他们的仙道潜力。
十年内成了炼丹师，拿炼丹分成慢慢还；十年内成不了，后半辈子便要替丹峰做事，按契约一笔笔还灵石。

虽然条件苛刻，但是普通练气弟子想要成为炼丹师，也只有这一条路可以走了。
楚无忌心里有数，不再多想，当即施展小风遁术，身形一晃，遁光贴着山道掠去，直奔丹峰。
丹峰与别峰大不相同，远远便能闻到多股药香混在一处，浓而不腻，像是整座山都在炼着什么。
山门外外门弟子抬着药篓来回穿梭，步履匆匆；内门弟子多半袖口微卷，不是沾着药粉，便是带着浅浅火燎痕。
山腰处白雾缭绕，雾中隐隐有阵法灵光流动，灵气被牵引得如潮汐起伏，竟是一座了囊括整座山峰的聚灵大阵。
楚无忌看了一眼，心里暗道：丹峰果然财大气粗。
他沿石阶上行，依照打听来的规矩，先到丹峰的丹契堂。
丹契堂门口立着一块黑石碑，碑上刻着八字：
“丹道贵信，契约必偿。”
楚无忌入内报了名。
管事弟子翻了翻名册，抬眼打量他一眼：“你就是辛十三号斗法台那个当值执事？”
楚无忌拱手：“是。”
content_en:
It was time for the Law Enforcement Hall to happen, so Chu Wuji turned around and went to the Scripture Collection Pavilion.
The pines outside the Sutra Pavilion are rustling in the wind, and the copper bells on the eaves are ringing softly. The atmosphere is much more relaxed than that of the Law Enforcement Hall.
Since there was no risk of his contribution points being deducted, Chu Wuji no longer hesitated. He spent all his income from being a deacon, as well as the contribution points he had saved in the past, and came to the Sutra Pavilion to exchange for two secret techniques.
The first one is "Xuan Gang Body Training", a method to assist in physical training, which is specially designed to replenish muscles, bones, skin and flesh, and stimulate Qi and blood. This skill is also considered a first-class body training method in the Qi training stage. Although it is a little slow to advance, it can lay a solid foundation without all kinds of heavenly materials and earthly treasures, just in time to prepare for the physical body level among the three levels of foundation building in the future. The three levels of foundation building, magic power, physical body, and spiritual consciousness, are indispensable. They all need to be transformed to build the foundation of the Tao.
In addition, there is a swift wind blade technique, which complements his wind spirit root. When activated with all his strength, it is sharp and powerful, no less than a high-level magic weapon.
The ruthless man who only had high-level magic weapons but fought all the way to the true inheritance relied on quick shots and accurate connections. Several spells were almost instantaneous and continuous, and he forcibly defeated a family monk who took out a talisman but had no time to activate it. No matter how powerful the talisman is, if it cannot be activated in time and cannot fall on the opponent, it is just a decoration.
After walking out of the Sutra Pavilion, Chu Wuji stopped and looked over the end of the stone steps, landing in the direction of Dan Peak in the distance.
If you want to get the Foundation Building Pill.
The fighting style is too dangerous. Even if you can win in the ring, you have to be careful not to strike too hard, lest someone takes advantage of the situation and cannot even argue. But if you are timid, something will inevitably go wrong.
Then, there is only one way left.
Ten seats for all kinds of arts.
Alchemy, weapon refining, talisman making, formations... among all the various arts of cultivating immortality, his favorite was alchemy after all.
But alchemy is not just words. The threshold is there: a large number of spiritual stones.
In the Sea of Chaotic Stars, there is a widely circulated saying among the monks: "It will take three generations to refine an elixir, but it will take a lifetime to refine a weapon."
What we are talking about is that the consumables of alchemy are like a sea. One furnace after another is scrapped due to trial and error. The spiritual stone flows out like running water, which is enough to empty out the savings of several generations. But the weapon refining is more fierce, the failure is greater and the loss is greater. It is also easy to blow up the furnace and harm the body. At the least, it destroys the magic weapon and materials, and at worst, it damages the meridians and the Tao foundation, directly cutting off the path of cultivation.
Chu Wuji touched the storage bag. Inside was the scattered spiritual stones he had saved over the years, which amounted to less than ten yuan. But if you really want to embark on the alchemy path, you may not even be able to afford a decent alchemy furnace with these spiritual stones.
How can you become an immortal if you don’t have money?
But he didn't just try his luck with empty words.
As early as a few days ago, he had found out clearly: In order to expand the number of people available, Danfeng used Danfeng's excess spiritual stones to open the door to some disciples who wanted to learn alchemy and enhance their immortal potential.
If you become an alchemist within ten years, you will slowly pay back your alchemy share; if you fail to become an alchemist within ten years, you will have to work for Danfeng for the rest of your life and pay back the spiritual stones piece by piece according to the contract.
Although the conditions are harsh, this is the only way for ordinary qi-training disciples to become alchemists.
Chu Wuji knew what he was doing, so he stopped thinking about it and immediately used the Little Wind Escape Technique. With a sway, the light escaped along the mountain road and headed straight for Dan Peak.
Danfeng Peak is very different from other peaks. From a distance, you can smell multiple medicinal fragrances mixed together. It is thick but not greasy, as if the whole mountain is practicing something.
Outside the mountain gate, the outer disciples carried medicine baskets and walked back and forth in a hurry; most of the inner disciples' sleeves were slightly rolled, either stained with powdered medicine or lightly burnt by fire.
White mist shrouded the mountainside, and there was faint spiritual light flowing in the fog. The spiritual energy was pulled up and down like the tide, and it turned out to be a large spiritual gathering formation that encompassed the entire mountain peak.
Chu Wuji took a look and thought to himself: Danfeng is indeed rich and powerful.
He walked up the stone steps, and according to the rules he learned about, he first went to the Danqi Hall in Danfeng.
There is a black stone tablet standing at the entrance of Danqitang, with eight characters engraved on it:
"Alchemy means trustworthiness, and the contract must be repaid."
Chu Wuji entered and signed up.
The steward disciple turned over his nameHe looked up and looked at him: "Are you the deacon on duty at Xin No. 13 Fighting Platform?"
Chu Wuji cupped his hands and said, "Yes."
